causes.label: demand
causes.quote: These high price events occurred on the third day of a heat wave that affected South Australia, Victoria and southern New South Wales.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Plant failures on 14 January at AGL's Torrens Island B unit 3 (200 MW) in South Australia, Loy Yang A unit 3 (around 560 MW) in Victoria, and cooling limitations at Loy Yang B reduced the capacity of the B1 and B2 units by 99 MW.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: During the 4 pm trading interval there was no capacity priced between $100/MWh and $8000/MWh, and, as a consequence, small changes in demand, small reductions in import capacity from Tasmania, and some rebidding triggered large increases in price.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: Capacity priced at $12,000/MWh at Loy Yang B was dispatched, but because it was ramp rate limited it did not set the price.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: During the 4 pm trading interval there was no capacity priced between $100/MWh and $8000/MWh, and, as a consequence, small changes in demand, small reductions in import capacity from Tasmania, and some rebidding triggered large increases in price.

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood
interconnectors_named.quote: The Heywood interconnector was unconstrained during the high price period

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink

interconnectors_named.quote: Flow into Victoria across the Vic-NSW interconnector

intervals.text: The 4 pm trading interval is comprised of the six dispatch intervals from 3.35 pm to 4 pm inclusive.

peak_price.quote: At 4 pm on Wednesday 15 January 2014, the spot price reached $6213/MWh and $5972/MWh in South Australia and Victoria respectively.

rebid_set_price.quote: During the 4 pm trading interval there was no capacity priced between $100/MWh and $8000/MWh, and, as a consequence, small changes in demand, small reductions in import capacity from Tasmania, and some rebidding triggered large increases in price.
